description: Capabilities for the muse main window. Deliberately minimal: the UI talks to the gateway over plain HTTP/fetch, so only core window + tray permissions are granted, plus window-state persistence. No filesystem, shell, HTTP-plugin, or clipboard scopes are opened. tauri-plugin-shell and tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager are registered in Rust but used ONLY from Rust (brain.rs spawns `muse cockpit serve`; the Copy Gateway URL menu action writes the clipboard in on_menu_event) — deliberately no shell:* or clipboard-manager:* permission here, so the webview can neither execute processes nor touch the clipboard. App-defined commands (gateway_status/start/stop, autostart_get/set, gateway_url_hint_set) are application commands, which Tauri v2 does not ACL-gate.
